_comment: Official and indicator sources fetched by tools/fetch.py (no browser). Consumer direct-ship observations come read-only from the retail_reference path in config.json; sellers are published by letter, named in methodology.md. Append-only in spirit: retire, never delete.

sources.name: Maine DMR: lobster landings by month, county, and zone (PDF)
sources.label: OFFICIAL STATISTIC (annual publication of monthly pounds and value)
sources.why: State ex-vessel landings (pounds and dollar value) by month, 2004 to the latest complete year, published about once a year in February with the latest year marked preliminary. Value divided by pounds is the ex-vessel price per pound: the price paid at the dock, the closest public series to what a supplier's supplier pays. Lags by up to a year; monthly preliminary figures for the current year are not in this file.

sources.name: NOAA Fisheries FOSS trade data: live lobster imports (Homarus spp.)
sources.label: OFFICIAL STATISTIC (monthly import value; not a retail price)
sources.why: Only monthly, official, machine-readable series with a live-lobster line. Implicit unit value (dollars per kilo of live Homarus imports, mostly Canadian, landed at Portland ME and other districts) is a wholesale-level directional indicator. Published with roughly a 2-3 month lag.

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: PPI and CPI series (public API v1)
sources.label: FOOD-COST INDICATOR (index, not a lobster price)
sources.why: Official monthly indices. WPU02230503 is the PPI commodity index for lobsters; WPU0223 unprocessed and prepared seafood; WPUFD4111 finished consumer foods; CUUR0000SEFV CPI food away from home; CUUR0000SAF11 CPI food at home. API v1 needs no key (25 queries/day).

titles.WPU0223: PPI commodity: Unprocessed and prepared seafood (NSA)
titles.WPUFD4111: PPI final demand: Finished consumer foods (NSA)
titles.CUUR0000SEFV: CPI-U: Food away from home, U.S. city average (NSA)
titles.CUUR0000SAF11: CPI-U: Food at home, U.S. city average (NSA)

sources.name: USDA ERS Food Price Outlook (CPI forecast table)
sources.label: FOOD-COST INDICATOR (official forecast table)
sources.why: Monthly USDA table of year-over-year CPI changes and forecast midpoints by food category, including fish and seafood and food away from home. The CSV link carries a cache-buster that changes each release, so the landing page is captured and the current link followed at run time.
